name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native architect workflow routed by default for every request, with direct primary-only simple lanes, native Luna V2 delegation for engineering work, and explicit app-task or Terra/Sol compatibility lanes.

interface.shortDescription: Default routing for every request; direct primary-only simple lanes and native Luna V2 delegation for engineering work.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor routes every new request by default while keeping simple, status-only, install-only, commit/push-only, and no-subagent work in a direct primary-only path. Engineering work that benefits from delegation uses native V2 roles through gpt-5.6-luna at max effort; architecture, verification, and acceptance remain in the primary session. App-task Luna and legacy Terra/Sol are explicit compatibility options, and an explicit request not to use Sol Advisor or orchestration opts out.
defaultPrompt: Route every request through Sol Advisor; keep simple lanes primary-only and delegate engineering to native Luna V2.
Use app-task Luna or legacy Terra/Sol only when I explicitly authorize compatibility.
